pipeline: 1. Run detect_material_bgr.py per material parameter file using objects[*].parameter_files; each material stores scene-specific JSON files under configs/materials/<物料名>/.
2. Run repair_material_segmentation.py for images with no/poor detections, using objects[*].repair.prompts and objects[*].repair.thresholds.
4. Labels written to metadata are pure material names; numeric dataset/output counts stay in input/output paths only.

selection_rules.multi_container_policy: Use max_instances=2 only on multi-container prefixes; use max_instances=1 on single-container prefixes.
selection_rules.multi_container_prompts: Multi-container scenes use size/front-back single-crate prompts (larger/smaller crate only, front-lower/rear-upper crate only) so touching crates separate into two complete instances; greedy whole-crate prompts are avoided there because they merge both crates or only catch the larger crate's liner.
selection_rules.occlusion_policy: Convex completion is disabled in multi-container scenes: the convex hull cut the corners of rotated crates and could not recover a missing crate face. Masks follow the true crate outline; non-convex lower/front crate priority is applied before rear crates so the exposed crate stays complete and touching crates separate. Trade-off: a liner-filled crate shows its liner opening through the mask instead of being a solid blob.
selection_rules.late_151422_repair: Profile box1_151422_late_right_attached_repair covers 20260526_151422__000097 through __000119 with side-specific prompts.

selection_rules.open_issue_draped_film: Single-container prefix 20260526_101913 (and likely 103230/103841) has a translucent plastic liner/film draped out of the crate onto the floor, physically contiguous with the crate. Text-prompt SAM cannot reliably separate it (stable within an angle cluster but flips between clusters), so these frames still include the film. Pending a depth/height-based exclusion or per-cluster repair decision.
